1: # Desktop-flow quality audit — round 10
2: 
3: Scope: independent reachability, ownership and recovery review of existing R04 / R05 / R07 / R13 / R28 / R29. Latest source snapshot is `/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/review-latest-20261012/codeshell`, commit `a66f4ef291f304ee4df9da8095a90671d9a8f140`. Read CODESHELL.md, the old main report, Desktop rounds 1/3, quality-audit notes, existing portable fixtures and logs. No product source, repository report, build output or goal state was changed. All six relevant implementations listed below have no source diff between `84740d56` and `a66f4ef2`; these are not newly introduced by the latest snapshot.
4: 
5: 第二十轮依据触发范围与既有恢复将R29降为P3，见[后续交叉裁定](r29-priority-round20.md)；下文六项P2是第十轮历史裁定，原证据与恢复仍成立。
6: 
7: **Historical verdict: retain all six P2 findings.** This round adds no new defect. Strong counterevidence narrows R05 to stale path/metadata plus blocked execution, R07 to a Core `exited` event while an independent external turn remains active, R13 to a throwing submit handler rather than permanent renderer failure, and R29 to a recoverable live projection error rather than durable project deletion. R28 requires an incomplete authoritative initial refresh; ordinary post-load toggles preserve unrelated entries.
8: 
9: ## Targeted controls and evidence
10: 
11: Evidence directory: `/tmp/codeshell-review-20261012-desktop-quality-round10/`.
12: 
13: | Fixture and matching `.log` | Latest result | New evidence |
14: | --- | --- | --- |
15: | `composer-recovery-controls.test.tsx` | 3 pass / 16 assertions / 0 fail / 0 skip | Actual ChatView: remove stale path chip before sending B; same-session plugin expansion; late expansion after React unmount |
16: | `question-recovery-control.test.tsx` | 1 pass / 9 assertions / 0 fail / 0 skip | Actual ChatView: selecting B's valid visible option does not remove hidden A index; an intervening session with no question remounts the sticky view and B submits once |
17: | `plugin-settings-durable-controls.test.tsx` | 2 pass / 17 assertions / 0 fail / 0 skip | Actual ManagePage + PluginsTab + real Main writeSettings/readSettings under isolated HOME: initial race durably replaces arrays; normal loaded toggle preserves alpha; observed actual React mount IPC call order is plugins:list, skills:list, settings:get |
18: | `project-recovery-control.test.tsx` | 1 pass / 9 assertions / 0 fail / 0 skip | Existing real-store startup migration repro extended through actual useSessionNavigation.handleRenameProject for the still-visible original project: Main's new broadcast restores both projects while active B is retained |
19: 
20: Total: **7 targeted tests / 51 assertions / 0 failures / 0 skipped**. This is not a full-suite rerun. Each was run separately from the latest workspace with `node scripts/run-bun-test-shard.mjs --timeout 15000 /tmp/codeshell-review-20261012-desktop-quality-round10/<name>.test.tsx`. Runner completion was checked in every final log. The project fixture's two expected Git “not a git repository” probes concern owned plain temporary directories; they are not product failures or failed tests.
21: 
22: Safety and limits: guarded runner supplies an isolated real HOME and removes inherited provider credentials. Fixtures install fetch/http/https/net/tls connection guards **before local Core-facing dynamic imports**. Plugin writes touch only isolated user settings; project stores use owned temporary directories. No real models/APIs, third-party downloads, user plugins, microphone, browser account or running user service. UI tests use the repository mini DOM and actual React handlers, not a real Electron/browser click session. Network guards cover the tested in-process APIs, not an OS network sandbox.
23: 
24: ## R04 — retain: delayed expansion has a live route to B's draft
25: 
26: Primary evidence: `packages/desktop/src/renderer/ChatView.tsx:978–987` and `packages/desktop/src/renderer/App.tsx:376–383`.
27: 
28: Production App renders its main ChatView without a session identity key (`App.tsx:2442`); changing engineSessionId/sendBucket keeps that component mounted. Expansion captures A's pluginCommandTarget and awaits IPC at ChatView:981, then checks only mountedRef before calling setDraft(:986–987). App's setter picks activeBucketRef.current *when applying the update*, which is now B. The actual IPC handler `packages/desktop/src/main/index.ts:3989–4000` awaits rendererConfigurationCwd before expansion; even a local command has a real asynchronous IPC/authority boundary. This does not depend on an external model or network operation.
29: 
30: The local expanding flag disables composer controls (`ChatView.tsx:838–839`), but does not block sidebar navigation: App:2195 calls navigateFromSidebar; that callback comes from useResponsiveSidebar (`App.tsx:234`) and simply executes or defers the navigation until drawer close (`packages/desktop/src/renderer/app/useResponsiveSidebar.ts:46–55`). It has no knowledge of ChatView's expansion state. Thus “A expansion pending, switch directly to B containing a pre-existing draft, successful late result” is reachable. Do not claim the user must type B's draft during the disabled interval.
31: 
32: Original portable `reproductions/desktop/composer-session.test.tsx` second case proves A target and B overwrite (5 assertions). New controls establish normal same-session completion updates A only; React unmount before resolution leaves both source command and B draft intact. Those guards are real but do not protect same-mounted session changes. A retains its original slash command, while the overwritten prior B draft is not restored by the success path. Confidence high.
33: 
34: ## R05 — retain: local reference state crosses sessions, Core prevents reading A's file
35: 
36: Primary evidence: `packages/desktop/src/renderer/ChatView.tsx:443–444,1082–1097`; unkeyed App main surface at :2442. Parent text/image draft maps are per-bucket (`App.tsx:372–394`), but localFilePaths/inputReferences remain in the same ChatView. addLocalFilePaths attaches A's session metadata at ChatView:882–909. No switch-specific reset was found.
37: 
38: A can drag/select a workspace file, switch to B without sending, and submit B's own prompt. Original portable composer fixture confirms bucket B, a literal A path in B's prompt, and structured attachment sessionId A. Strong counterevidence: actual Core `packages/core/src/engine/input-attachments.ts:131–143` rejects the mismatch and continues **before stat/read at :149+**. Therefore the demonstrated impact is path/metadata crossing and B's input being rejected, not A file contents read under B's authority. Existing R06 separately explains native error invisibility; R05 remains a distinct composer-state root cause.
39: 
40: New actual ChatView control clicks the carried file chip's real remove handler before B's Enter. Both literal path and structured reference disappear; B sends its original text with no attachment errors (6 assertions). This matches removeLocalFilePath at ChatView:912–916 and visible remove button :1774–1777. Recovery is available by removing the visible stale chip; normal send also clears local paths/references after submission (:1106–1109). This does not preserve the original attachment draft per session. Confidence high.

45: 
46: Primary location: `packages/desktop/src/renderer/ChatView.tsx:1374` and `:1577`; local terminal state in `packages/desktop/src/renderer/approvals/ApprovalCard.tsx:68-72`, `:94-97`, `:139-149`.
47: 
48: Both inline and sticky ApprovalCard instances are rendered without a request identity key. `decided` initializes only once. When the queue still has another request, deciding the first replaces props in the same component; React retains `decided` for the second request. `MessageStream` trailingKey is a scroll trigger (`MessageStream.tsx:199`), not a React identity key.
49: 
50: Trigger: the model requests two GenerateImage operations in one response in default permission mode; approve the first once. Real builtin metadata marks GenerateImage concurrency-safe (`packages/core/src/tool-system/builtin/index.ts:333-343`), while default PermissionClassifier returns ask (`permission.ts:1573-1584`). `StreamingToolQueue.enqueue` immediately starts each safe call (`streaming-tool-queue.ts:46-53`). A separate real Core queue/executor/permission test reaches two simultaneous pending approvals before answering either; both are denied in the test so no provider is contacted. Bash is serial and is not needed for this production trigger.
51: 
52: Impact: second request's tool content appears with `已批准` and no allow/deny controls, though no decision was sent for it. The agent remains blocked until another surface is opened or the card remounts. This can also occur across conversations if switching directly between pending cards.
53: 
54: Verification: `approval-queue.test.tsx` renders actual ChatView with req-A and req-B, approves req-A, then checks req-B's `second image` description is visible, `仅本次批准` has disappeared, `已批准` appears, and decision call count remains 1 (1 pass / 5 assertions). Confidence: high.
55: 
56: Suggested correction: key ApprovalCard by sessionId/requestId or explicitly reset all local request state when that identity changes, in both rendering sites.
57: 
58: ## D5 [P2] A delayed plugin command overwrites the next conversation's unsent draft
59: 
60: Primary location: `packages/desktop/src/renderer/ChatView.tsx:981-987`; destination selection at `packages/desktop/src/renderer/App.tsx:376-383`.
61: 
62: Trigger: run `/demo:review src/A.ts` in conversation A; while command expansion IPC is pending, switch to B, which already contains an unsent draft. ChatView remains mounted and only checks mountedRef after the await. Parent's draft setter chooses activeBucketRef.current when the promise completes.
63: 
64: Impact: A's expansion replaces B's entire unsent draft; A retains the original command. This is actual user draft loss, separate from D2's stale synchronous attachment state. Similar identity handling is worth checking for transcription and image staging.
65: 
66: Verification: second case in `composer-session.test.tsx` renders actual ChatView and uses the same dynamic-ref parent setter as App. Expander starts with `{sessionId:"A"}`; after switching, B's `B 已经写好的重要草稿` becomes `A 的 review 命令展开内容`, while A stays `/demo:review src/A.ts` (1 relevant pass / 5 assertions). Confidence: high.
67: 
68: Suggested correction: capture the source bucket and draft revision at invocation, write results to that source draft, and preserve text edited during expansion.

70: ## D6 [P2] Sticky AskUser state crosses request boundaries and breaks the next question submit
